description: Triggers for completion claims that need fresh, fingerprint-bound evidence: done, fixed, passing, ready for review, ready to release; filling or auditing the PR Verification and Trace sections; checking the sdlc-dod Definition of Done; treating a PR description or agent report as testimony

queries.query: Task T4 is finished — run whatever is needed so I can say it's done
Fill in the Verification table of the PR body with fresh evidence for every AC
The PR says all tests pass and there are no regressions. Check whether that is actually true
Is the evidence in this PR stale? A commit was added after the Developer ran the tests
Do the two-way gap check: any AC without a passing test, or code nobody asked for?
Run our Definition of Done from the sdlc-dod block and tell me if the PR meets it
The subagent reported DONE on the migration task. Can we trust that and move on?
AC-3 depends on a third-party API with no sandbox — how do I record that it can't be verified before release?
Before I tell the team the bug is fixed, what proof do I need?
Re-run the checks and decide whether the evidence supports a GO on this pull request
Design the acceptance tests for spec 007 from the spec only, before any code exists
Review this diff for correctness, security and design issues across all lenses
Write a failing test first for the parser change, then make it pass
The test suite started failing after the upgrade — find the root cause
Execute the plan in specs/004-invoice-pdf task by task
Write the spec with acceptance criteria for the CSV export
Plan the staged rollout and rehearse the rollback for tomorrow's release
